I read the 10 reviews dated between May 05, 2023 and Jun 13, 2025 and classified each by hand, with no sentiment model. Six came out negative:

- May 05, 2023: "This thing is horrible… It's just awful."
- Jun 13, 2025: tells the reader to skip *The Flock* entirely.
- Jun 21, 2023: "this stinker", with flat acting and tedious direction.
- Feb 01, 2024: "just silly garbage."
- Jan 05, 2024: the reviewer was fast-forwarding after 20 minutes.
- Jun 11, 2024: "very poor" directing and weak acting.

The other four I judged positive:

- Apr 10, 2025: the reviewer says they rated it 8.
- Aug 01, 2023: calls the film "quite engaging".
- Feb 04, 2024: "very good".
- Jul 01, 2024: "a brilliant one".

The Jan 05, 2024 review is the closest call. I only read the first 700 characters of each review, and that one opens with "I enjoyed the feel of the opening few minutes". I counted it as negative because the rest of the visible text is critical.

Ten reviews fall in the range. Six read as negative:
- May 05, 2023: "This thing is horrible", "just awful".
- Jun 13, 2025: a "knock off" of Se7en that tells the reader to skip it.
- Jun 21, 2023: a "stinker" with flat acting and tedious direction.
- Feb 01, 2024: "silly garbage".
- Jan 05, 2024: the reviewer was fast-forwarding after 20 minutes. This is the least clear-cut of the six.
- Jun 11, 2024: "the directing is very poor", "Almost a B movie".

The other four read as positive:
- Apr 10, 2025: the reviewer enjoyed it and rated it 8.
- Aug 01, 2023: described as "quite engaging".
- Feb 04, 2024: "very good" and "fun".
- Jul 01, 2024: "a brilliant one".
